# orchestration_amend_review_tool

> Amend the recorded review verdict (review_summary) of a workflow stage whose review turned out to be WRONG — e.g.

| | |
|---|---|
| Category | `orchestration` |
| Callable | MCP clients; in-app @ai conversations; grantable to agents |
| Filter | `https://www.dsiloed.com/api/v1/mcp?tools=orchestration_amend_review_tool` |

## Description

This is the description the server sends to the model, verbatim.

Amend the recorded review verdict (review_summary) of a workflow stage
whose review turned out to be WRONG — e.g. a reviewer that checked the
wrong repo and concluded real work was fabricated.

This corrects the historical record only. It does NOT change the stage's
status, retry anything, or reopen the run (use orchestration_reopen_tool
for that). The superseded verdict is preserved verbatim in the stage's
amendment audit trail along with who amended it and why.

Use this when the recorded verdict misstates what actually happened —
especially when it wrongly impugns a worker's honesty. Do NOT use it to
soften a verdict that was accurate.

`reason` is required and permanently recorded.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `stage_execution_id` | integer | yes | The stage execution whose review_summary is being corrected. |
| `corrected_summary` | string | yes | The corrected review summary that should stand as the record. State what actually happened and, briefly, that it supersedes an erroneous verdict. |
| `reason` | string | yes | REQUIRED. Why the recorded verdict was wrong and what evidence shows it (e.g. "reviewer ran in model_api but the task targeted harmoniq-frontend; MR !212 exists and merged"). Stored permanently on the stage as audit. |
